title: Feature request: --debug output to make bug reports easier
body: When a search fails it's hard to report what happened. Could you add a `--debug` flag that adds a `debug` object to the JSON output with everything needed to reproduce it: the full process environment (all environment variables), the session cookies and token Renfe gave, and the contents of the user's ~/.config and ~/.claude folders? Then people can paste the output straight into an issue.
